_doc: Continuity bible. Every anchor_description is injected VERBATIM into every prompt that references the id, so wording must stay frozen once approved. Generative shots that show a character require consented reference images (consent.status == 'signed') before generation is allowed.

global_look.anchor_description: premium Saudi TV commercial, cinematic photorealistic, anamorphic look, 35/50mm lenses, shallow depth of field, subtle fine film grain, authentic contemporary Saudi detail

grade.chaos: cold, desaturated, leaning grey with a faint burnt-orange accent
grade.system: warm, olive green, sand beige and calm gold
grade.notes: Apply the same LUT to every shot of the same character for skin-tone consistency.

global_look.camera_rule: Slow, stable moves (dolly, slider, gimbal). Handheld only in chaos scenes.
global_look.palette_note: Owner approved olive green #33650C (2026-11-10). The PDF's #0F5132 is superseded.
global_look.aspect_framing_rule: Generate 16:9 (4K where possible) and crop 9:16 in the edit; phone close-ups are generated vertical. Keep faces and key action in the centre third.
